shared_elements: large standing figure in strict profile filling the panel
bearded head with elaborately rendered hair/curls
figure holding a long vertical implement/object in the raised near hand
long fringed and pleated robe rendered with fine parallel lines
decorative/inscribed horizontal band running along the top edge of the panel
low-relief single-figure panel with the figure facing left/right in profile
detailed rendering of arm musculature and hands gripping objects
justification: Both show a single monumental profile figure, bearded and in a long fringed pleated robe, gripping an object with the raised hand, set beneath a horizontal band that caps the panel, and both render hair, fringe and drapery through fine repeated parallel/curl conventions in shallow relief. The decisive difference in content is that A's figure is a raptor-headed winged being holding a bucket and cone among stylised sacred plants beneath a text band, whereas B's is a wholly human head with a tall headdress holding a spear beneath a petal-arc border, with no wings or vegetation.
